tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Search the library for what the Small Business Owners Community has learned about an owner's question. Use this first for any small business question, however it's worded: "raise my prices," "a client won't pay," "can't find good people," "working too many hours," "nobody to talk to about the busine

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Get the opening and outline of one post or episode, with the link to the full thing. Use after search_library or whats_new when the person wants more on one result. Never returns the full post.

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: List the newest posts and episodes added to the library, newest first. Use when someone asks what's new, what Pat talked about lately, or what was on the latest Businessing episode. Returns 8 unless count is set.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_document, whats_new · Private data: get_document · Public sink: get_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_document, whats_new · Private data: get_document · Public sink: get_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
